class.name: Bullet
class.brief_description: [color=green](User creatable)[/color] A bullet node used in the UT-Godot-Engine battle system. Implements Undertale-style damage, effect modes, and more.
class.description:
[Bullet] is a core node that implements bullets for Undertale-style battle systems.
[b]Damage Modes[/b] • [code]MODE_WHITE[/code]: Normal bullet (standard) • [code]MODE_GREEN[/code]: Healing bullet (HP recovery) • [code]MODE_BLUE[/code]: Blue bullet (damage when moving) • [code]MODE_ORANGE[/code]: Orange bullet (damage when stopping)
[b]Example (GDScript)[/b] [codeblock] extends Bullet
func ready(): # Initialize bullet damage = 10 set_mode(MODE_BLUE) velocity = Vector2(0, 200) # Move downward
func on_hit_player(): print("Hit player!") queue_free(); [/codeblock]
[b]Notes[/b] • The [method Node._physics_process] function cannot be overridden. • When [member delete_upon_hit] is true, the [method on_hit_player] function is not called. • [member sprite_path] must be set
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

method.name: ready
method.description: Bullet initialization function. Should be used instead of the [method Node._ready] method.

method.name: on_hit_player
method.description: Virtual function called when colliding with the player soul. Used to implement special collision effects or interactions. [b]Note:[/b] This function is not called if [member delete_upon_hit] is true.

method.name: on_hit_yellow
method.description: Virtual function called when hit by a bullet fired by the yellow soul. Used to implement special interactions in yellow soul mode.

method.name: on_hit_player_shield
method.description: Virtual function called when blocked by the green soul's shield. Used to implement shield interactions or special effects.

method.name: _physics_update
method.description: Function called every physics frame. Should be used instead of [method Node._physics_process].

method.name: set_mode
method.description: Sets the bullet's damage mode. Color is automatically changed to match the corresponding mode. Returns itself, allowing method chaining.

method.name: get_mode
method.description: Returns the currently set damage mode of the bullet.

method.name: fade
method.description: Deletes the bullet with a fade-out effect. Reduces opacity to 0 over 0.5 seconds before deletion. Emits the [signal bullet_fade] signal.

signal.name: bullet_fade
signal.description: Automatically emitted when [method fade] is called.

constants.constant: Does not change the mode. Maintains the currently set damage mode.
Normal bullet mode. Always deals damage when colliding with the player. Displayed in white color.
Healing bullet mode. Restores HP when colliding with the player. Displayed in green color.
Blue bullet mode. Only deals damage when the player is moving. Harmless when stationary.
Orange bullet mode. Only deals damage when the player is stationary. Harmless when moving.
